## Design decisions recorded at implementation

Full rulings in ADR-0315; the load-bearing ones:

- **One evaluator** — `evaluate_debt` delegates the §05b
  observable legs to `hh-compiler::expiry::
  evaluate_debt_record` and merges the manager-level
  triggers (profile-change, evidence-supersession,
  probation-overrun) into the same `StatusTransition`
  list; a hard transition subsumes warn causes for the
  same rule; causes sorted + deduplicated.
- **`ComponentTargetKind` is a closed sum** — `leaf`
  canonicalizes to `text_leaf`; unknown kinds refuse;
  >64 targets refuse rather than truncate.
- **One hosted admissibility predicate** — a hosted arm
  joins M1 only under `observation_substitution` ∧
  `interception: model_io` ∧ `granularity:
  configuration`; every other hosted row renders
  `n/a{class}` (AC-R-2.9.7-10).
- **Allocations never pool and never silently drop** —
  `uniform` below the search floor emits null effects
  with the `below_search_floor` reason and
  `budget_allocation_ref` beside them (KA-I7-4);
  `concentrated` funds only `concentrated_on`.
- **`retirement` is estimand-preserving** — M1 over the
  target set plus a closed `removal_verdict` grammar; a
  funded null effect passes, an LOI interval excluding 0
  fails, a below-floor or `n/a` cell is inconclusive.
- **The regression fold is drift-first** — `drifted`
  names the moved rules (sorted+deduped) and only those
  rules read `expiring` through `regression_drifted_
  rules`; `broken` names its evidence ref and expires
  nothing it cannot attribute.
- **Synthetic claims are honest about unobserved
  members** — `drift:<ref>` ids, no weights digest,
  unknown policy exposure/cutoff, no serving route; a
  *missing* claim still refuses `UnpinnedSnapshot`.
- **R2 gains two basis rows** — `B-R2-profile` /
  `B-R2-images`; `[]` satisfies; a missing pin lowers
  the level with the gap named, never silently.
- **The manager surface is records-in/records-out**
  (AC-R-2.9.6-10) — Group L ops exchange
  `DebtIndexRow`/`RemovalVerdict`/`DebtReport`/
  `SnapshotClaim`/`RegressionVerdict` documents over
  `hh-embed/1`; the embed fold is byte-identical to the
  in-process `hh_lab::debt::debt_index` fold (asserted
  by test).

## Removability

`removability(0…3)` green (serial script run). Every new
surface is additive (CC8): `ComponentTargetKind`/
`RegressionVerdict`/`DebtNoticeKind`/`ProfileChangeKind`
are new closed sums; `evaluate_debt_record` is a new
public wrapper; `profile_refs`/`images` are new members
with empty defaults; the Group L ops register beside the
existing roster; the catalogue rows append. No new crate,
no new feature gate; C0–C3 fixtures decode and run
unchanged.
